newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Advantage appoints Keith Davis as ceo.
newsitem.headline: Advantage appoints Keith Davis as ceo.

text.p: Advantage Group Ltd, a supplier of electronic scanning equipment, said on Wednesday it had appointed Keith Davis as its chief executive.
Davis is a former chief executive of mobile phone company BellSouth, and computer company Compaq Computer.
"Last month the board signalled that the market could expect a depressed second half result for the year ended June 30," Advantage said in a statement.

"With a new strategic approach and vision, a different board and a new CEO of Mr Davis' calibre heading the company at the start of a new year, Advantage is set to begin turning around that performance."
Advantage said it had been largely responsible for the success of New Zealand's extensive EFTPOS infrastructure, which boasts the highest penetration rate of businesses in the world.
"Advantage has supplied approx 70 percent of all EFTPOS terminals in use in retail outlets in New Zealand and 20 percent in Australia," the company said.
